conventions.emotes: emote_* are 64x64 frames (trimmed in the atlas, anchor = centre), soft-3D, no text. Show them inside ui_emote_bubble (bubble scale ~0.75, emote at the same scale placed at the bubble contentCenter) or floating alone at scale ~0.7 with a pop (0 -> 1.15 -> 1 in ~200 ms) and a gentle bob. Readable down to ~32 px.
conventions.emoteBubble: ui_emote_bubble anchor = tail tip: put it at the villager anchor + (0, headTop - 4) (times the character scale). Emote centre = anchor + contentCenter * bubbleScale.
conventions.chatBubble: Speech bubble = nineslice(ui_chat_bubble, w, h) with origin (0.5, 1) at (x, y) + image ui_chat_tail with origin (0.5, 0) at (x + dx, y - 20). Tail tip = (x + dx, y + 5) -> to point at a head top P use y = P.y - 5. Keep |dx| <= w/2 - 36. Sizes 80x56 .. 320x96 (any size >= 80x56 works). Text: dark #2B2F3A, ~20 px, centred in the content box (inset l12 r12 t8 b18). For an emote inside a chat bubble use scale ~0.55.
conventions.blend: All spritesheets are NORMAL-blend artwork with dark tinted rims: they read on snow, plaza and sea.
conventions.sheets: Horizontal strips, frame i at x = i*frameWidth. Phaser anim key = sheet key.

spritesheets.notes: Snowball impact burst: squash, lumpy splat, chunks flying out and falling. Anchor = impact point (where fx_snowball hits, e.g. the target's face/chest ~ anchor + (0, -40)).
Seamless loop of rising, swaying notes (purple/pink/blue/gold). Anchor = bard's lute / head side. Notes rise ~85 px.
One-shot: 5 hearts pop up one after another and float ~80 px up. Anchor = head top.
One-shot: two dark huff puffs blast out sideways from the head + throbbing red anger vein above. Anchor = head top (character anchor + (0, headTop)).
One-shot: 4 sweat drops spring off the head in arcs. Anchor = head top.
EXTRA (not in contract): looping Z shapes drifting up-right for dozing villagers (grandpa on the bench). Anchor = head top; use flipX when the sleeper faces right.

emote_love.notes: Face with heart eyes + blush (loves it / crush).

emote_laugh.notes: Squinting laughing face (>< eyes, wide open mouth) with tears flying.

emote_sweat.notes: Awkward smile ^^; with a big sweat drop (embarrassed / nervous).

emote_zzz.notes: Three blue Z shapes (sleeping / dozing on the bench).

emote_cold.notes: Blue shivering face, chattering teeth, red nose, snow on the head.

emote_tear.notes: Sad crying face with tears (sad / hurt feelings).

emote_bread.notes: Warm bread loaf with steam (talking about bread / hungry).

emote_wave.notes: Waving hand with a red parka cuff (hello / bye).

emote_thumbs.notes: Thumbs up with a red parka cuff (good / nice).

ui_emote_bubble.notes: Round emote bubble (~81 px across) with tail at the bottom centre; anchor = tail tip. Draw the emote at anchor + contentCenter (scaled with the bubble). Recommended bubble scale 0.75.

ui_chat_bubble.notes: 9-slice speech-bubble BODY (no tail; add ui_chat_tail). Bottom 9.8 px of the frame are drop shadow. See conventions.chatBubble.

ui_chat_tail.notes: Tail for ui_chat_bubble. Origin (0.5, 0) at (bubble x + dx, bubble bottom - 20): it merges seamlessly with the body outline. Tip = anchor + tip. Mirror-safe (symmetric).

fx_snowball.notes: Thrown snowball (~22 px). Lighting is baked from the upper-left: do not rotate. Fly it on a parabola (~0.35-0.5 s) with a soft ground-shadow ellipse below; on arrival play fx_snow_splat at the hit point and the target's hit anim.
